The Code 128 check digit is mandatory and occupies a full symbol position, with the start character weighing 1 and the first data symbol also weighing 1, so the sum is written V

map.⚠️ 打印提示：条码两侧须留出不小于 10 倍最窄模块宽的静区（EAN-13 建: ⚠️ Printing tip: leave a quiet zone of at least 10 times the narrowest module width on both sides (EAN-13 recommends 11 modules left and 7 right), and keep black bars on a white background at no less than 300 dpi, otherwise scanners misread easily. The viewfinder generated by this tool already reserves quiet zones per each symbology standard.
map.输入 12 位前缀 690123456789，工具按加权模 10 算出校验位 2: Entering the 12-digit prefix 690123456789, the tool computes the check digit 2 by weighted mod-10 and generates the full EAN-13 barcode 6901234567892; when printing, leave a quiet zone of at least 9 times the narrowest bar width on each side, otherwise scanners misread easily.

map.内部物流、含字母或长度不定的编号用 Code128；零售商品且已申请 GS1 厂: Use Code128 for internal logistics and alphanumeric or variable-length codes; use EAN-13/UPC for retail products with a GS1 company prefix. The two cannot be mixed and scanning devices must be configured accordingly.
